business_purpose: Only complete leads are routed
condition: All channel-required fields present and valid
exception_handling: Referral with missing FSA but known branch: manual review
acceptance_criterion: No lead with a missing required field has an active RM assignment

business_purpose: Never route an unresolved duplicate
condition: duplicate_status in (unique, rejected_match)
acceptance_criterion: No lead in DUPLICATE_REVIEW or MERGED has an active assignment

business_purpose: Route only in-scope SME prospects
condition: Band 1-499, operating in Canada, sector not 91, no existing relationship
exception_handling: Existing relationship: redirect to existing owner
acceptance_criterion: Every INVALID lead from this rule has an eligibility disposition

business_purpose: Route only leads ready for assignment
condition: lead_status = READY_FOR_ASSIGNMENT
exception_handling: Audited reopening re-enters here; reassignment and override decisions (decision_type reassignment or override) evaluate leads already in active work
acceptance_criterion: Every routing decision was taken while the lead was READY_FOR_ASSIGNMENT

business_purpose: Apply channel-specific starting ownership
condition: CH-RMP self-assigns to the prospecting RM; CH-BRN/CH-PTR may name a preferred RM
exception_handling: Prospecting RM at hard capacity: route normally
acceptance_criterion: RM-prospected leads are self-assigned unless a capacity or territory rule blocks it

business_purpose: Resolve CMA and province before territory
condition: FSA resolves to an SGC 2021 CMA or provincial remainder consistent with province
exception_handling: Conflict or missing geography: see TER rules
acceptance_criterion: Every assigned lead has a resolved territory or a manual-review queue record

business_purpose: Prefer RMs covering the lead's territory
condition: RM has an effective territory covering the lead
acceptance_criterion: Territory-match rate is reported for every assignment

business_purpose: Match SME size segment to RM segment coverage
condition: Micro (1-19) to small-business RMs; established (20-499) to commercial RMs
exception_handling: No segment match: any territory RM
acceptance_criterion: Segment-match flag recorded on every decision

business_purpose: Apply mandatory or preferred specialist matching
condition: Mandatory industries require a specialist; preferred industries favour one
outcome: Specialist candidates first (or only, if mandatory)
acceptance_criterion: No mandatory-specialist lead is assigned to a generalist without an approved override

business_purpose: Honour an explicitly stated service-language preference
condition: Only when the prospect explicitly stated a language; never inferred
exception_handling: No matching RM: assign and flag for interpreter support
acceptance_criterion: No routing decision uses a language that the prospect did not state

business_purpose: Honour a referrer's named preferred RM
condition: Preferred RM is active, in territory and below warning capacity
exception_handling: Preferred RM at capacity: ignore preference, record reason
acceptance_criterion: Preference is ignored whenever it would exceed the warning threshold

business_purpose: Exclude unavailable RMs
condition: RM on leave, absent or inactive on the decision date
acceptance_criterion: No assignment is made to an RM unavailable on the assignment date

business_purpose: Exclude RMs at or above hard capacity
condition: Utilization in the latest capacity snapshot (as of 00:00 UTC on the decision date) at or above the hard limit (CAP-06)
acceptance_criterion: No assignment exceeds the hard limit without an approved override

business_purpose: Exclude RMs with a recorded conflict or who declined this lead
condition: RM has a recorded conflict of interest or declined this lead before
acceptance_criterion: No lead is reassigned to an RM who declined it

business_purpose: Spread work to the least-loaded eligible RM
condition: Lowest workload utilization among remaining candidates
acceptance_criterion: Selected RM has the minimum utilization among eligible candidates, or a documented tie-break

business_purpose: Resolve ties deterministically
condition: Equal utilization: longest time since last assignment, then lowest synthetic RM id
acceptance_criterion: Identical inputs always produce the same RM

business_purpose: Hold leads when no territory RM is eligible
condition: No eligible candidate after exclusions
outcome: QUEUED assignment owned by the Regional Sales Manager
acceptance_criterion: Every queued lead has a named queue owner

business_purpose: Hold out-of-CMA, remote or specialist leads centrally
condition: Remote-service territory, national specialist need or uncovered territory
outcome: QUEUED in the national or specialist queue
acceptance_criterion: Every national or specialist queue entry has an owner and ageing SLA

business_purpose: Route ambiguous geography or conflicts to a person
condition: Unresolvable geography or conflicting province and CMA
acceptance_criterion: Every manual-review entry has a reason

business_purpose: Allow controlled manual assignment or reassignment
condition: Regional Sales Manager or Director applies an override with a coded reason
exception_handling: Override above hard capacity is limited by CAP-09
acceptance_criterion: Every override has a reason code and actor role

business_purpose: Escalate leads that remain queued or unassigned
condition: Queue age exceeds the assignment SLA breach threshold
outcome: Escalation raised to the Regional Sales Manager, then the Director
acceptance_criterion: Every breached queue entry has an escalation event
